entities.summary: Richard Philip James Laurenson is a New Zealand priest of the Catholic Church who has served as the fourth bishop of the Diocese of Hamilton since 8 December 2023. Prior to his appointment as bishop, he served as a parish pastor and canon lawyer for the diocese.
